_comment: 二轮复核轮：词素表修正后新通过 21 号的 15 词（此前一直被 A6/A18 拦下，没有选过例句），由复核 AI 手写补齐（Tatoeba 里挑不到带中文对照、又无专名的现成句）。

another.exampleEn: May I have another cup of tea?

company.exampleEn: He works for a small software company near the river.
company.exampleCn: 他在河边一家小软件公司工作。

lemonade.exampleEn: We drank cold lemonade under the big tree.
lemonade.exampleCn: 我们在大树底下喝了冰柠檬水。

somewhere.exampleEn: The keys must be somewhere in the house.
somewhere.exampleCn: 钥匙一定在屋子里的某个地方。

announce.exampleEn: The mayor will announce the results tomorrow morning.
announce.exampleCn: 市长明天早上会宣布结果。

nowhere.exampleEn: The road led nowhere after the old bridge.
nowhere.exampleCn: 过了旧桥，这条路就哪儿也到不了。

woollen.exampleEn: She wore a warm woollen scarf in winter.
woollen.exampleCn: 冬天她围着一条暖和的羊毛围巾。

reproach.exampleEn: His words were full of quiet reproach.
reproach.exampleCn: 他的话里满是轻声的责备。

wide.exampleEn: The river is very wide after the heavy rain.
wide.exampleCn: 大雨过后这条河非常宽。

panic.exampleEn: Do not panic when the fire alarm rings.

wherever.exampleEn: Sit wherever you like in the garden.
wherever.exampleCn: 在花园里你想坐哪儿就坐哪儿。

immigrate.exampleCn: 许多家庭为找更好的工作而移居。

whereas.exampleEn: He is tall, whereas his brother is quite short.
whereas.exampleCn: 他个子很高，而他弟弟相当矮。

widely.exampleEn: This medicine is widely used in hospitals.
widely.exampleCn: 这种药在医院里被广泛使用。

whereby.exampleEn: They made a deal whereby both sides shared the cost.
whereby.exampleCn: 他们达成了一笔双方分摊费用的交易。

retard.exampleEn: Growth was retarded by the long drought.
retard.exampleCn: 长期的干旱使生长迟缓。

explorer.exampleEn: The explorer mapped the old road through the hills.
explorer.exampleCn: 那位探险家把穿过山丘的古道画了下来。

organiser.exampleEn: She is the organiser of the school trip.
organiser.exampleCn: 她是这次学校旅行的组织者。

settler.exampleEn: The first settler built a hut by the river.
settler.exampleCn: 第一个定居者在河边搭了间小屋。

villager.exampleEn: The villager sold one hundred eggs to the merchant.
villager.exampleCn: 那个村民把一百个鸡蛋卖给了商人。

announcer.exampleEn: The announcer read the news at noon.
announcer.exampleCn: 播音员在中午念了新闻。

liner.exampleEn: The liner left the port at dawn.
liner.exampleCn: 那艘定期船天一亮就离开了港口。

manufacturer.exampleCn: 这家工厂是本地最大的汽车制造商。

miner.exampleCn: 矿工六点下到了坑道里。

observer.exampleEn: The observer wrote down everything he saw.
observer.exampleCn: 观察员把看到的一切都记了下来。

rider.exampleEn: The rider stopped to let the horse drink.

glider.exampleEn: The glider rose on the warm air above the hill.
glider.exampleCn: 滑翔机乘着山上的暖气流升高。

hover.exampleEn: A bird can hover above the field for minutes.
hover.exampleCn: 一只鸟能在田野上方盘旋好几分钟。

peer.exampleEn: He is my peer, so we share the same work.
peer.exampleCn: 他是我的同辈，所以我俩干一样的活。

taper.exampleCn: 过了桥，这条路开始变窄。

originate.exampleEn: The fire is thought to originate in the kitchen.

residence.exampleCn: 他们在老城区住了下来。

illuminate.exampleEn: Street lamps illuminate the whole road.

instruct.exampleEn: She will instruct the class on how to use it.

collect.exampleEn: We collected shells on the beach.

renew.exampleEn: I need to renew my passport.

election.exampleEn: The election will be held next week.

lecture.exampleEn: He gave a lecture on history.
lecture.exampleCn: 他做了一场关于历史的讲座。

newly.exampleEn: The newly built bridge opened today.

general.exampleEn: The general idea is easy to understand.

special.exampleEn: Today is a special day for us.

structure.exampleEn: The structure of the book is clear.

pressure.exampleEn: He is under a lot of pressure.

success.exampleEn: Hard work is the key to success.

refer.exampleEn: Please refer to the notes below.

obtain.exampleEn: You can obtain a copy online.

sector.exampleEn: He works in the public sector.

access.exampleEn: Students have access to the library.

picture.exampleEn: Look at the picture on the wall.

ordinary.exampleEn: It was an ordinary working day.
ordinary.exampleCn: 那是平常的一个工作日。

impact.exampleEn: The book had a big impact on me.

service.exampleEn: The service here is very good.

insist.exampleEn: I insist on paying for it.

retain.exampleEn: We retain the right to refuse.

impose.exampleEn: They impose a tax on fuel.

scientist.exampleEn: He wants to be a scientist.

minor.exampleEn: It is only a minor problem.

circle.exampleEn: Draw a circle on the paper.

temporary.exampleEn: This is only a temporary fix.

opposite.exampleEn: The bank is on the opposite side.

remote.exampleEn: They live in a remote village.

mixture.exampleEn: Add the mixture to the pan.

distant.exampleCn: 她听到远处传来的声音。

distance.exampleEn: The distance is about two miles.

sensation.exampleEn: It caused a sensation at the time.

venture.exampleCn: 他们开始了一项新的冒险。

continuous.exampleEn: There was continuous rain all night.

generous.exampleEn: He is very generous with money.

devise.exampleEn: We must devise a new plan.

assert.exampleEn: He did not assert his rights.

delight.exampleEn: She read the letter with delight.

duration.exampleEn: What is the duration of the trip?

accent.exampleEn: He speaks with a strong accent.

justification.exampleEn: There is no justification for it.

successor.exampleCn: 他们选定了他的继任者。

envisage.exampleCn: 我们设想一个更好的未来。

assemble.exampleEn: We assemble the parts by hand.

excess.exampleEn: There is an excess of sugar.

dedicate.exampleEn: She wants to dedicate her time.

gravel.exampleEn: The path is covered with gravel.

packet.exampleEn: He opened a packet of seeds.

pronounce.exampleEn: How do you pronounce this word?

designate.exampleCn: 他们将指定一位负责人。

denote.exampleEn: It can denote anger or fear.

texture.exampleEn: I like the texture of this cloth.
